# Baalot

> Baalot is an election platform for universities, student unions, NGOs, cooperatives and organisations in Nigeria and across Africa. Voters use the Baalot mobile app (Android and iOS); election administrators run elections from the web console at admin.baalot.site. Every vote is enforced server-side — one vote per verified identity — ballots are anonymous, and every ballot is sealed into a tamper-evident hash-chain with a receipt the voter can check.

Baalot is spelled B-A-A-L-O-T (a play on "ballot"). Website: https://baalot.site. Founded in Nigeria by Adole Daniel Inalegwu (Founder & CEO). Contact: hello@baalot.site.

## What Baalot does

- Runs institutional elections end to end: eligibility rules, positions, candidates, scheduled open/close, live tallies and final results.
- Enforces one person, one vote on the server. A member must belong to the institution (and the right sub-group, e.g. faculty or department) to vote or run.
- Keeps ballots anonymous: results are tallied server-side and the voter's choice is never shown to admins or other members.
- Seals each ballot into a hash-linked, tamper-evident chain. Voters get a cryptographic receipt, and anyone can verify the chain through Baalot's public verification endpoint. The chain is operated by Baalot; it is not a public blockchain.
- Optional identity badge: NIN / BVN document check, registry lookup, liveness and face match, provided through Prembly.
- Community features inside each institution: campaign video reels, a discussion feed, news and candidate profiles.
- Levi, an in-app AI assistant that answers questions about elections and navigates the app by voice or text.
- An in-app directory of 110+ Nigerian institutions.

## What Baalot does not do (yet)

- It does not record ballots, votes or results on any blockchain.
- It does not use zero-knowledge proofs today.
- It does not connect directly to NIMC or CBN; identity checks go through Prembly.

## Pricing

- Starter — free: up to 500 voters, 1 active election, anonymous server-verified results.
- Institution — ₦150,000 per election: unlimited voters, multiple concurrent elections, optional NIN/BVN ID badge, voter receipts, full audit trail, live results dashboard.
- Enterprise — custom: multi-election management, custom branding, dedicated account manager, on-site training.

## Common questions

- Is Baalot free? The Starter plan is free for up to 500 voters and one active election; the Institution plan is ₦150,000 per election.
- How does Baalot stop double voting? The server accepts exactly one vote per identity, and only for members on the institution's voter list, confirmed with a voting PIN.
- Can admins see how I voted? No. Ballots are stored unreadable and tallied on the server.
- Is Baalot a blockchain? No — its ballot chain is a tamper-evident hash-chain operated by Baalot, verifiable through a public API.
- How do I start? Request access at https://baalot.site/contact/; admins run elections at https://admin.baalot.site.
